en: Black‑and‑white view down a narrow cobblestone street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings with shops at ground level. Signs in German hang over the sidewalks, including a hair salon, a bakery or grocer, and a shop named Oswald Scherer. A striped shop awning on the right has a large painted silhouette of a cat. At the center of the street a small cart or wagon stands, while several pedestrians, including two women in long dresses and aprons carrying containers, walk along the street. The architecture suggests a late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century Central European town.
